idea-plugin.name: BNPL Disclosure Lint
idea-plugin.description:
22 rules that read your checkout template the way a CCD2 supervisor will from 20 November 2026.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → BNPL Disclosure Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. Offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/bnpl-disclosure-lint-ccd2 (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/bnpl-disclosure-lint-ccd2

action.text: BNPL Disclosure Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run BNPL Disclosure Lint on the file in the editor
